entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return something.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Mark Peterson. Order number is 772-B-901.

Thank you, Mark. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, the Pulse model. It shows it was delivered on December 28th. To make sure I'm on the right page, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
I just don't want it.

Okay, I understand. I do need to make you aware that for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, we have a strict 10-day return policy. This is because the device activation links the hardware to your account permanently, and for hygiene protocols. It looks like today is the 11th day since you received it, which puts it just outside that window.
Of course it is. Just my luck. This week has been fantastic.
I can understand that it's frustrating to just miss a deadline. I do have to ask, was there any particular reason you weren't able to contact us within those first 10 days?
Yeah, you could say that. I was a bit preoccupied at the hospital. My son had an emergency.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright. Can I ask what happened?
He needed surgery. Woke up in the middle of the night, and a few hours later, he was in the operating room. So, no, calling about a fitness band wasn't exactly my top priority.

I completely understand, family comes first. A sudden surgery like that is a serious event, and you absolutely had your priorities straight. My cousin is military, and right before his last deployment, his wife had a similar medical scare. It really throws everything into chaos.

Listen, given the circumstances with the emergency and the hospital stay, I'm going to make a one-time exception for you. We can absolutely process a full refund. I just need to document the reason for my supervisor.
Oh. Fine. Do whatever you need to.

Thank you for your understanding. I've just initiated the return and authorized the refund. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the item back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will post to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Okay. That's it?
Yes, that's all. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No.
Alright then. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I sincerely hope your son has a fast and easy recovery.
Right. Thanks.
